en: "Eek, you perv! Jeez!{n} Don't go pawing at a lady's body{n} like that!"
"A manufactured human, and you call{n} yourself a lady? If you don't want{n} to get hurt, quit giving me trouble!"
"Hey, don't be too rough with it.{n} If it starts bawling, it'll be{n} more than we can handle."
"I know that! How many of our{n} buddies got killed because of{n} this doll!?"
"I didn't kill anybody!{n} They just went and died{n} all on their own!"
"And I'm not a doll, either!{n} My name's Alice! I'm a proper{n} human girl!"
"Human, my ass! Died on their own,{n} my ass! You things are Esper Dolls!{n} Living dolls, artificially made!"
"I bet even that water that looks{n} like tears is something they{n} made artificially, huh?"
"It gets you to drop your guard,{n} then rips enemy soldiers to pieces.{n} One well-made doll, I swear!"
"Don't let it get to you. Let's hurry."
"The report says one more survivor{n} is left. The Rhodes bunch are out{n} to recover it, too. We get it first!"
"Well, well. Looks like you've{n} finally noticed."
"You there, boy. Are you a soldier?"
"No mistake, looks like he is. See{n} that uniform? Type's a bit off, but{n} it's the gutless Romulus army!"
"Heh heh. Looks like you get to{n} live, boy. As it happens, we're{n} busy. Now get out of here, quick!"
"I'm busy myself. Sorry to{n} interrupt. Carry on as you like."
"A girl of about ten, by the look{n} of her. Rheinmetall's heavy infantry{n} must be really hard up for women."
"Honestly, what a thick-headed boy.{n} We gave you your chance, and{n} you'd rather go and die, huh?"
"No way! Why would a Romulus{n} soldier know about Esper Dolls?"
"Too bad for you, I'm not exactly{n} a regular soldier."
"I'm with the Romulus army's Special{n} Service Agency. I know every{n} country's dirt far better than you."
"Rhodes developed it in secret and{n} first sent it into real combat on{n} this island: the Esper Girl Corps?"
"It was meant to be a cutting-edge{n} bioweapon, but the tech was unfinished{n} and the mind conditioning incomplete."
"The Esper Girl Corps destroyed{n} itself. But Rheinmetall intelligence{n} went after the survivors."
"Odd story, though, isn't it?{n} Rheinmetall and its vassal Rhodes{n} are supposed to be on good terms..."
"And yet, in all this confusion,{n} you're trying to capture{n} an Esper Doll."
"Looks like you plan to use this{n} chance to get your hands on the{n} Rhodes army's military secrets."
"Looks like we can't let you go now."
"Yeah. If he's Special Service,{n} that's all the more reason we{n} can't leave him alive."
"Hold on. It's not just each{n} country's dirt. There's one more{n} thing I know very well."
"Yeah. You two die here.{n} I already know that..."
"A sword!? Using a sword in this{n} day and age... Are you of knightly{n} blood, you bastard!?"
"Th-that's it! I heard in Ship Town!{n} The rumor of a Romulus Dark Knight{n} who maimed our buddies in the tavern!"
"Go ahead and try. If you can."
"Strong... Far, far too strong...{n} ...Is this... a real...{n} knight's sword?"
"You people just don't know it.{n} At times, a single sword{n} beats a thousand guns."
"Tch. No fight in them at all.{n} The proud name of Rheinmetall{n} must be weeping."
"You were soooo cool! Hey, hey, hey?{n} You're the prince who came{n} to rescue me, aren't you?"
"No! You are, I just know you are!"
"I've dreamed of it for sooooo long!{n} That a prince on a white horse{n} would come to take me away!"
"What a lovely day it is! My life{n} saved by a prince! Oh, if this is{n} a dream, don't let me wake up!"
"What I ride is no horse. It's a{n} steel Void Carrier, a big powered{n} vehicle that runs on a rotary engine."
"And I'm no prince, of course. I'm{n} a Republic of Romulus soldier: Special{n} Service Agency, dirty work only."
"I saved you only because I judged{n} that our army needs a sample{n} of an Esper Doll..."
"I've heard of an Esper Doll's{n} power, too: more than a trained mage.{n} That will help my mission as well."
"Listen. I'll tell you just one thing."
"If you're grateful to me, then{n} from now on fight as I order. If{n} I tell you to die, you die. Got it?"
"From today, I'm your master.{n} You're not a person, you're a doll.{n} So I hold first claim of ownership."
"Because you're my prince!{n} I'm fine with dying any time!"
"I'll do anything you order! So stay{n} with me! I got separated from my{n} friends, and I've been so sad!"
"If you're by my side when I die,{n} I can die any time and{n} not be scared at all!"
"But let me say it just once more!{n} Thank you so, so much, my prince!"
"Fine. I need something to call you.{n} Got that, Alice? You work{n} for me and me alone."
"My esper powers are yours{n} to use however you like!"
"And I can use Voids, too!{n} I'll be super useful, so please{n} don't throw me away, my prince!"
"This one... Too much mind{n} conditioning, maybe...?"
"We were in the middle of a fight{n} back there, so I kept my{n} mouth shut, but..."
"This brat you picked up is{n} a surviving Esper Doll,{n} isn't she!?"
"That's right. Got a problem with it?"
"It's because of you things that{n} we ended up pulling out of this{n} island of steel!"
"The Esper Dolls: the ultimate bioweapon{n} Rhodes finished in secret, hidden{n} even from its ally Rheinmetall."
"But the Esper Dolls were a failure.{n} Afraid the secret would leak, the{n} army itself pulled out of the island."
"A brat like this is the reason{n} we pulled out! I can't let her{n} stay alive!"
"I'm not a brat. I'm a girl!"
"Girl, my ass! Bodies carved up,{n} brains messed around with... What{n} part of you things is a girl!?"
"That's rich, you murder doll!{n} Show me that power of yours!{n} Fight me, right here and now!"
"A heavy gunner and an Esper Doll!{n} Let's settle which one is{n} the better soldier!"
"That's enough, Parsifal. We're{n} always short of hands. We can't{n} afford to lose valuable fighters."
"Oh, you're going to save me!?{n} I knew it! You really are{n} my wonderful priiince!"
"You don't have to buy it.{n} Just don't kill this kid for now."
"Then I'll put up with it{n} for a little while!"
"When you've done what you came to{n} this island for, the brat is mine!{n} You fine with that, {hero:6}!?"
"Good enough! I'll hold off on{n} getting rid of the brat till then!"
"I told you. You're not a person,{n} you're a doll. So I have{n} ownership of you."
"Having ownership means I also{n} have the right to let you go."
"Okay, I get it. If I can be with{n} my prince until then, I don't mind{n} that I'm sure to die!"
"Special Service Second Lieutenant{n} {hero:6}, are you there?"
"Quick on your feet as ever.{n} That's a Special Service Captain{n} for you, I guess."
"I did get an urgent D-code, after all."
"So, I hear you've obtained a{n} sample of the Esper Dolls the{n} Rhodes army was developing..."
"I see. Looks like an ordinary{n} girl. We've had intel on Rhodes's{n} test subjects for some time."
"But this is my first time{n} seeing the real thing."
"More to the point, what do we do{n} with her? You want a sample to study.{n} Ship her home and cut her up?"
"We have no troops to spare to move{n} a sample. And what matters now is{n} the treasure on this island of steel."
"Yes. Once we have the treasure the{n} gods left behind, Esper Dolls are{n} nothing but children's toys."
"After all, it's an army of thousands{n} of Machine Gods and power over even{n} the weather. No new weapon compares."
"The Esper Doll is yours to handle.{n} You must be short of fighters. Used{n} well, it'll make a useful weapon."
"Sorry. A Rheinmetall navy fleet{n} nearing this island's coast is{n} making suspicious moves right now..."
"We have no forces to send your way."
"Come on. Wasn't finding the{n} treasure supposed to be{n} the top priority?"
"First, a sea route to send troops{n} in. And for that, clearing out the{n} Rheinmetall navy comes first."
"Nice for you officers in the rear.{n} Never mind how hard we have it{n} out in the field, huh?"
"Don't be like that. Anyway, I'm{n} counting on you."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
"Tch.{n} So the enemy made off with the chest!"
"O blazing flames,{n} become a storm and destroy the foe..."
"...Deadly lightning, become a flash{n} piercing heaven and earth, and show{n} the murderous foe your true power..."

"Water of light,{n} become a shield and guard us."
"Wall! O wall of swirling flame!{n} Bar the enemy's way and{n} grant us the power of protection!"
"Hear my name! Call my name!{n} A proud name, filled with glory!"
"Race across the sky! Pierce the heavens!{n} The ultra-long shot... Range Plus!"
"This one's no ordinary bullet!{n} Round in the chamber!{n} Hammer cocked! Target!"
"Rocks in the sky, clouds on the ground!{n} ......Art of Falling Rocks!"
"The gates connect, O eight gates!{n} ...Art of the Strange Gates...{n} Earth Formation!"
"Magic and strikes, be sealed!{n} Battle arts, be shut away{n} by the Law of Sealing!"

"Come forth... my minions...{n} puppets of the dead...{n} The word that wakes you... Doll..."
